name: Alaska Communications
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public alaskacommunications.com support pages only (no sign-in). Alaska Communications is the largest incumbent local exchange carrier in Alaska (Anchorage, Fairbanks, Juneau). The online account is AccountView: existing customers choose Create Account and need the account number plus the CPNI password; a registration code is emailed to the address on file (CPNI password is not expressible, so accountNumber + email are modelled). Sign-in is by username and password; Forgot Username and Forgot Password both email recovery messages. QuickPay pays all invoices in one transaction without signing in, by Visa, MasterCard or Discover only (guestMethods card); its lookup fields are not described on the pages used, so the family default lookup is kept. In AccountView: Make Payment (date, amount, method, Continue, Complete Payment); Manage AutoPay below Make a Payment (bank account or credit/debit card, choose a Payment Date, Enroll); a balance must be paid in full before AutoPay takes effect (not expressible). View Current Bill opens the PDF. Phone payments: 24-hour secure line 907-563-3279 (Anchorage) or 800-808-8083. Mail: PO Box 196666, Anchorage, AK 99519-6666, no cash. Disconnecting service is by calling 800-808-8083. Updating contact information online is currently unavailable (call 800-808-8083). Convenience fees, late fees, paperless billing and payment arrangements are not described on the public pages used (family defaults kept, no fee charged).

guest_pay.note: QuickPay accepts VISA, MasterCard and Discover and can pay all of your Alaska Communications invoices in one transaction.

autopay.note: If you have a balance, pay it in full before AutoPay takes effect.

help.title: Bill payment options
paragraphs: AccountView: log in to make a one-time payment, set up AutoPay and see current and previous invoices. Select Make Payment, choose a date, amount and payment method, then Continue and Complete Payment.
QuickPay: pay all of your Alaska Communications invoices in one transaction without logging in, with VISA, MasterCard or Discover.

Phone: the secure 24-hour line has no hold time. Call 907-563-3279 in Anchorage or 800-808-8083 statewide. Mail: send a check with the remittance slip to PO Box 196666, Anchorage, AK 99519-6666 and write your account number on it. Please do not send cash.

help.title: Set up AutoPay in AccountView
paragraphs: Log in and select Manage AutoPay below the Make a Payment button. Choose a bank account or a credit or debit card, give it a nickname, enter the details and Save. Then choose a Payment Date and select Enroll.
If your account has a balance, pay it in full before AutoPay takes effect. To change the card or bank account later, use Manage AutoPay again.
steps: Add or choose a payment method and Save.
Pick a Payment Date and select Enroll.

help.title: Create your AccountView login
paragraphs: Choose Create Account on the login page. You need your account number and your CPNI password. Select Get Registration Code and a code is sent to the email address on file; enter it with your CPNI password, accept the terms and continue.
You log in with a username and password. Forgot Username and Forgot Password send a recovery email to the address on your account.

help.title: Disconnect service
paragraphs: Disconnecting service is handled by phone. Call 800-808-8083. Moves can be ordered in AccountView with Change, then I'm moving to a new address.
